title: Infant formula, Similac Isomil Soy, powder, made with baby water

content.title: About
content.content: Similac Isomil Soy is a soy‑based infant formula powder designed for babies who are lactose intolerant or have a cow‑milk protein allergy. It provides plant protein, essential vitamins and minerals, and is prepared with specially treated baby water for added purity and safety.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is completely plant‑based and contains no cow’s milk.
Formulated to support immune health and gentle digestion in infants with sensitive stomachs.
Includes DHA and ARA, important fatty acids for brain and eye development.
Each package comes with instructions for preparation using baby water, reducing contamination risk.
Similac Isomil Soy has undergone clinical testing confirming its safety and efficacy.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Provides a balanced mix of protein, fat, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals needed for normal infant growth and development.

items.title: Gentle on digestion
items.content: Soy protein is easier to digest for babies with lactose intolerance, helping to reduce colic and constipation.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, D and zinc help strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: Added DHA and ARA contribute to the development of the nervous system and visual function.

items.title: Reduced risk of cow‑milk allergy
items.content: Absence of cow‑milk protein lowers the chance of allergic reactions in susceptible infants.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some infants may be allergic to soy proteins; discontinue use if symptoms appear.

items.title: Not a substitute for breastfeeding
items.content: Intended as a supplement or alternative only when breastfeeding is not possible.

items.title: Proper preparation required
items.content: Incorrect water‑to‑powder ratio can lead to hyper‑ or hypoglycemia.

items.title: Storage considerations
items.content: After opening, keep the container in a dry, cool place and use within the stated period.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Measure the recommended amount of powder, add the appropriate volume of pre‑boiled and cooled baby water (e.g., 1 scoop per 30 ml), and mix thoroughly until smooth. Use the prepared feed immediately and do not leave it at room temperature for more than 1 hour.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 30 days and discard if the formula develops an off‑odor or changes color.
